description: Take a screenshot of a public web page in a real headless browser and return it as an MCP image (PNG or JPEG) plus JSON metadata. Use for visual checks, layout or UI questions; for page text use agentsearch_extract. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 screenshots per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.004). Read-only: it loads the page like a browser visit. The page shown is untrusted third-party content.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page (clipped at 4000 px) instead of the viewport.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL to capture.

name: agentsearch_screenshot
title: AgentSearch Screenshot
